table.name: TLGNR_MAP_QTY_RESTR_BS
table.description: Storing the contract types and order reasons for orders which are quantity restricted.

column.name: QUANTITY_CONTROL_FLAG
column.description: If value == 1 than quantity is restricted

column.name: ADVANCE_PAYMENT_FLAG
column.description: If value == 1 than contract is an advance payment contract

column.name: CTL_ACT_CD
column.description: Active Flag. When new data is entered, only reference data with active flag are available for selection normally.
